Admin address, defaults to owner, gates onlyAdmin functions (payouts, redenomination, voting).
Global circuit breaker flag checked by most state-changing functions.
Redenomination round counter (1..9) driving mul[] and decimal logic.
Epoch counter (1..10) limiting game lifecycle and voting.
uint[8] array of burned decimal digits; mutated by renewDec and redenominate.
uint[9] multiplier table indexed by round used to truncate balances.
uint[9] per-digit dividend amounts computed by redenominate and consumed by updateAccount.
Token reservoir for the current epoch paid out by payout().
10% team fund accrued in payout and withdrawable by owner.
30% DAO fund accrued in payout and withdrawable by owner.
ERC20 total supply, mutated by payout, updateAccount, redenominate.
mapping(address=>Account) holding balance, lastRound, lastVotedEpoch, bitmask.
ERC20 allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount.
Flag enabling/disabling the ballot; consumed by onlyVoter.
Dynamic array of Project structs voted on during an epoch.
onlyOwner setter that reassigns admin.
onlyOwner two-step ownership transfer initiation.
Completes ownership transfer when called by newOwner.
private core payout routine: fixes amount, calls updateAccount/renewDec, splits team/DAO parts, mints and emits Transfer.
onlyAdmin payout of 0.555666XX whose value depends on block.timestamp%100.
onlyOwner arbitrary payout that forwards amount to payout().
ERC20 transfer: fix_amount, updateAccount on both sides, SafeMath balance moves, renewDec.
ERC20 transferFrom spending allowance with updateAccount/renewDec and SafeMath subtractions.
ERC20 approve writing allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Sets allowance then calls external spender contract receiveApproval — external call after state write.
Public dividend refresher mutating accounts, dec, current_toadd and _totalSupply based on round.
onlyAdmin round advance: truncates _totalSupply/team_fund/DAO fund, recomputes current_toadd with unchecked division.
onlyVoter ballot vote adding sqrt(balance) weight to a project and stamping lastVotedEpoch.
onlyAdmin epoch rollover: resets dec/round, increments epoch, refills epoch_fund, deletes projects.
onlyAdmin activation of voting when round==9.
onlyOwner withdrawal crediting accounts[to].balance from team_fund.
onlyOwner emergency freeze setting frozen=true.
onlyOwner rescue that calls transfer() on an arbitrary tokenAddress contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, voting, allowance and balance accounting.
Miner-influenced timestamp used in pay055/pay055loyal to pick the payout's last two digits.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an attacker-supplied contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary contract.
55566600 + (block.timestamp%100) makes minted amount miner-manipulable.
Unchecked multiplications/divisions (numbers[k]*1e9/total_current, k2e9[n]*unclimed/10/1e9) with no SafeMath and possible division by zero.
address to parameter of payout().
uint amount parameter of payout().
uint tokens parameter of transfer().
address from parameter of transferFrom().
Truncated amount computed by fix_amount inside payout().
10% team cut derived from fixedAmount inside payout().
Burned-decimal remainder of the user balance inside updateAccount().
dec[8-round] pool of unclaimed decimals read by redenominate().
dec[8-1-round] current active decimal sum used as divisor in redenominate().
Accumulated ke9 values for the first five digits in redenominate().
Truncated balance (tempDividedBalance*current_mul()) inside updateAccount().

edges.reason: setAdmin is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner (msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before reassigning owner.
msg.sender is the debit side of the ERC20 transfer.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender], so caller identity is authoritative.
approve writes the allowance under the msg.sender key.
approveAndCall stores the allowance for msg.sender and passes msg.sender to the callback.
onlyVoter enforces KYC bitmask, non-ban and lastVotedEpoch checks on msg.sender.
withdraw_team_fund is onlyOwner, authorising by msg.sender.
pay055 derives the minted amount from block.timestamp, making it miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp%100 feeds directly into the value passed to payout().
pay055 forwards the timestamp-derived amount to payout().
payCustom forwards the caller-supplied amount to payout().
pay055 executes the timestamp-dependent amount computation.
payout subtracts the total minted amount from epoch_fund.
payout credits team_fund with the 10% cut.
payout credits redenom_dao_fund with the 30% cut.
payout increases accounts[to].balance and consumes account state.
payout mints by increasing _totalSupply.
transfer refreshes recipient and sender via updateAccount before moving balances.
transferFrom calls updateAccount on both from and to.
transfer reads and writes accounts[].balance.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes an arbitrary spender contract after mutating allowance state, allowing reentrant control flow.
transferAnyERC20Token calls into an owner-supplied token contract, which can reenter the token.
updateAccount reads and writes the dec[] digit ledger through renewDec.
updateAccount consumes current_toadd[] dividends computed by redenominate.
updateAccount rewrites accounts[account].balance and lastRound.
redenominate increments and stores the round counter.
redenominate reads/clears dec[] entries to move burned decimals.
redenominate performs unchecked multiplication/division on total_current and unclimed without SafeMath or zero-divisor guards.
vote accumulates sqrt(balance) into projects[p].votesWeight.
StartNewEpoch clears the projects array via delete.
StartNewEpoch increments the epoch counter.
StartNewEpoch replenishes epoch_fund from total_fund.
enableVoting flips votingActive to true.
payout recipient parameter drives the account credited.
payout amount parameter drives fixedAmount and the funds split.
transfer tokens parameter is truncated and debited/credited.
transferFrom from parameter selects the debited account and allowance owner.
fixedAmount is the truncated value used for accounting inside payout.
team_part is derived from fixedAmount and credited to team_fund by payout.
diff is the burned remainder driving the Transfer and balance truncation in updateAccount.
unclimed divides into current_toadd inside redenominate and can overflow/truncate silently.
total_current is the divisor of numbers[k]*1e9 with no zero-check, risking division by zero.
k05summ accumulates unchecked products that scale the digits assigned to current_toadd.
newFixedBalance is the truncated balance written back by updateAccount.

normalization_plan.reason: Transient call argument; absorbing into payout removes nodes that carry no independent state.
Transient call argument; its effect is fully described by payout's dataflow edges.
Transient call argument; only meaningful as an input to the transfer value flow.
Transient call argument; its only role is selecting the debited account inside transferFrom.
Intermediate SSA value entirely contained within payout.
Intermediate value used only to credit team_fund inside payout.
Temporary arithmetic result local to updateAccount.
Temporary dividend pool read and consumed only inside redenominate.
Temporary divisor local to redenominate; keeping it separate adds no semantics.
Accumulator scoped to the redenominate loop body.
Intermediate truncated-balance value that only feeds updateAccount's writes.
